data.notes: April 2026 in Las Vegas was unusually dense, with Sphere rock residencies, a stadium-scale Bruno Mars tour launch, major niche festivals, and Strip nightclub programming all overlapping.

events.title: Viva Las Vegas Rockabilly Weekend 29
events.summary: The long-running Viva Las Vegas Rockabilly Weekend returned to The Orleans for its 29th edition, with live bands, DJs, dancing, burlesque, and car-show programming.

events.title: Bruno Mars – The Romantic Tour
events.summary: Bruno Mars brought The Romantic Tour to Allegiant Stadium for two Las Vegas stadium shows on April 10 and 11.

events.title: Eagles Live at Sphere
events.summary: Eagles continued their Sphere residency with a confirmed April 10 performance at the immersive Las Vegas venue.

events.title: Phish at Sphere
events.summary: Phish returned to Sphere for nine shows across three weekends: April 16–18, April 23–25, and April 30–May 2.

events.title: Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis – Nothing But Hits
events.venueName: Voltaire at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
events.summary: Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis brought a limited Las Vegas residency, billed around 40-plus years of hits, to Voltaire on select dates from April 17 through 26.

events.title: The B-52s – Love Shack: The Las Vegas Residency
events.venueName: The Venetian Theatre at The Venetian Resort
events.summary: The B-52s played a confirmed April 22 date of their Love Shack Las Vegas residency at The Venetian Theatre.

events.title: Pure Aloha Spring Festival & Concerts
events.summary: The 23rd Annual Pure Aloha Spring Festival & Concerts ran April 23–26 at Rio, with island and Pacific music programming including Ten Feet, Ekolu, and Kaipo Kapua on the Thursday bill.

events.title: Cyndi Lauper: Live in Las Vegas
events.summary: Cyndi Lauper staged her first-ever Las Vegas residency at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace, running from April 24 through May 2.

events.title: Sick New World Las Vegas
events.summary: Sick New World held its Las Vegas edition at the Las Vegas Festival Grounds on April 25, 2026.

events.title: Las Vegas City of Lights Jazz and R&B Festival
events.summary: The Las Vegas City of Lights Jazz and R&B Festival confirmed its 2026 edition for April 25–26, with its lineup page dedicated to the weekend program.

events.title: Smokey Robinson & Gladys Knight: Just the Two of Us
events.venueName: Pearl Concert Theater at Palms Casino Resort
events.summary: Soul and Motown legends Smokey Robinson and Gladys Knight co-headlined Pearl Concert Theater at Palms on April 25.

events.title: Martin Garrix with Justin Mylo at OMNIA
events.summary: Martin Garrix and Justin Mylo headlined OMNIA Nightclub, with the event listed from April 25 at 10:30 PM into the early morning of April 26.
